## Summary

<!-- What changed, and what problem does it solve? Keep the scope focused. -->

## Adoption, interoperability, or trust

<!--
How does this reduce adoption friction, improve interoperability, or create
verifiable technical confidence? For a very small correction, a short sentence
is enough.
-->

## Validation

<!--
List the commands and real environments used. Include the real QZX command when
public behavior changes, or explain briefly why a check does not apply.
-->

## Related issue

<!--
Link the issue for a new command, public contract change, large refactor, or
telemetry change. Use "Not required" for a focused correction.
-->

## Review checklist

- [ ] The change is focused and excludes secrets, private data, generated files, and machine-local artifacts.
- [ ] Tests and real-behavior checks are proportional to the change, with any omissions explained above.
- [ ] Public contracts, lifecycle metadata, documentation, and evidence are updated where applicable.
- [ ] Commits include a DCO `Signed-off-by` line as described in [CONTRIBUTING.md](../CONTRIBUTING.md).
- [ ] Adoption, compatibility, attribution, and logo claims are factual and supported by evidence or permission.
